id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bf94: "But my being a prince was long ago, and I thought I'd hidden my status. How did he see through me...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cba0: "But my being a prince was long ago, and I thought I'd hidden my status. How did he see through me...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b064: "What? Where did that guy go? I didn't hear that, but he said he'd look for the princess first.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b910: "What? Where did that guy go? I didn't hear that, but he said he'd look for the princess first.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c064: "What? Where did that guy go? I didn't hear that, but he said he'd look for the princess first.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc70: "What? Where did that guy go? I didn't hear that, but he said he'd look for the princess first.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b1ac: "A tower where a sky-galloping horse lives? Even I, who traveled the world, never heard of it. It'll be hard, but I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b37c: "A tower where a sky-galloping horse lives? Even I, who traveled the world, never heard of it. It'll be hard, but I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b2a8: "For the Yubar people, please get that golden mane!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b590: "Then fine. Don't forget about the golden mane.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bce4: "Then fine. Don't forget about the golden mane.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba3c: "You got the golden mane? Lyla will be thrilled! Hurry and give it to her!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb34: "You got the golden mane? Lyla will be thrilled! Hurry and give it to her!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bbdc: "Hm... you look like you want to ask something. Need me?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1e4: "I've told Lyla many times it's bad for the baby, but she says her body moves when she hears the tula.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c530: "I've told Lyla many times it's bad for the baby, but she says her body moves when she hears the tula.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2c4: "...Huh? Didn't I say? I'm going to be a dad, heh heh.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c610: "...Huh? Didn't I say? I'm going to be a dad, heh heh.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c334: "I can't go back to my homeland because of circumstances.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c680: "I can't go back to my homeland because of circumstances.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3b0: "I wish I could introduce our child to my father and sister I can't see anymore... and to my best friend.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c6fc: "I wish I could introduce our child to my father and sister I can't see anymore... and to my best friend.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e88c: "Rampaging by destructive impulse is the same as a pitiable monster with no heart. I don't want to become that yet...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e9d0: "Please tell the quarry workers that the Colorstones are back to normal. They'll surely be glad.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb80: "Brother, you're our only hope! If you defeat the monster boss somewhere in the quarry, let me know!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec48: "It happened so suddenly I can't explain well! Go see for yourself what's happening in the quarry...!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ed34: "Then I leave the rest to you! I'll pray for your safety here!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ee7c: "Whoa! Brother, you came back safe! You defeated that scary monster boss!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ef20: "Thanks to you, the Colorstones are back as before! We can work as usual! Thanks, take this!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|efec: "By the way, the green Colorstone is a rare gem found only here. It has the power to heal any illness.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f0ac: "If anything had happened to the green Colorstone in this fuss, the quarry would have been finished.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f35c: "If anything had happened to the green Colorstone in this fuss, the quarry would have been finished.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f164: "Brother, thank you truly. I won't forget this favor. Take care now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f2a8: "The green Colorstone is a rare gem found only here. It has the power to heal any illness.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f414: "...Hm, brother, you want to say something? What? The monster boss was a woman warrior in pink armor?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f4e4: "Hmm... I've never seen such a woman in this quarry. Not in the village either...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f5b0: "But well, if you say so, traveler, it must be true. She must have suffered, poor woman.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f7d8: "Traveler, are you going deeper? Then be careful. More people are getting lost and not coming back.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f8bc: "A little while ago a young blond fellow went into the quarry with a scary face, but he hasn't come out yet.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f990: "He said he wanted a green jewel, but I can't see it taking this long. I'm worried.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa8c: "Just now a young blond fellow left the quarry skipping. Something good must have happened.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fbec: "Naaah! Welcome! This is the mansion of Lord Rapan, father of the Killer Panthers!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc74: "Sadly Lord Rapan is out, but if you're interested in Killer Panthers, take your time in the garden!!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fdfc: "Lord Rapan, who lives in this mansion, and I both think no Killer Panther is bad to the core.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|feb4: "So that child who comes and rampages should turn into a good kid again once calm.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff70: "So, traveler, if you find something that could calm that child's heart somewhere, please bring it.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1003: "As she left, that child said something like 'Bian... ca?' It may hint at an item that calms the heart.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1021: "...I can tell. That child went home to someone she loves. It's all thanks to you. Thank you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|102d: "By the way, Rapan House has a Killer Panther fortune-telling. Want to do it?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1049: "Then let's start! Question one! If you named the first Killer Panther to join you, would Gelegele be good?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1059: "Question two! An old, frail Killer Panther looks at you as if wanting to join. Do you recruit it?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1069: "Final question! Living with a Killer Panther, do you prefer a thrilling adventurous life over a calm, peaceful one?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107f: "You're a carefree Shadow Panther! You go your own pace and don't mind others. If no problem, stay as you are.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1093: "You're a lazy Tiger Man! Are you tired from things going wrong? Don't make excuses, start acting.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10a7: "You're a romantic Bengal! A calm, happy life is actually hard to achieve. Effort is key.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10bb: "You're a shrewd White Panther! You judge things by profit and loss, but losing now and then is nice.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d0: "You're a lonely Snow Baby! You think relationships are a hassle but secretly crave contact.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e6: "You're a naive Baby Panther! You chase ideals, but seem to know and don't, so you struggle a lot.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10fa: "You're a selfish Shadow Baby! Honest with yourself, to put it nicely, but try to think of others a bit more.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|110e: "You're a mighty Killer Panther! Considerate and active, a wonderful person. If not, become so soon.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1122: "...That's about it. Did it hit the mark?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1159: "Naaah! Welcome! Boy, I was surprised. That tomboy Jessica cried...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1162: "She cried so much like a kid that we took her in to rest, and then contacted her mother to pick her up.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1174: "Yes yes. Jessica has to be like that! I'm glad she's back to normal.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ad: "Oh dear... what has happened to Jessica? My daughter isn't the type to cling to me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b9: "She always defies me and follows her own path. She overrode my objections and dashed off to avenge her brother.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ce: "This isn't my Jessica. Same body, totally different personality... How can I return her to normal?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11dc: "...Oh, that's right! A traveling merchant once told me of books that change your personality when read.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11ea: "You travel to many places, don't you? I'll reward you, so could you find a book that returns my daughter's personality?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1201: "Oh... I thought you were a kind young man, but you're rather cold. If you're busy, it can't be helped...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1216: "You'll do it, thank you. My daughter is a bit cheeky, but upright and full of energy.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1223: "The merchant said such books also exist in a country called Aliahan. Please find a book to restore her personality.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1244: "My daughter Jessica isn't a clingy type who cries just because I'm not nearby.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1250: "She follows the path she believes in even against me. A little cheeky, but upright and full of energy. That's her personality.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1260: "A traveling merchant once told me there are books that change personality when read.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|126c: "There are several kinds, and a country called Aliahan has one. Please find a book to restore her personality.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|128c: "I've been waiting. You brought the book to restore Jessica's personality, right?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1296: "Thank you. Um... which one is the book?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|129b: "You want me to have her read "Secrets of the Mighty"?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a0: "Is this "Humor Book" the one that restores Jessica?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12a6: "You can't mean to have Jessica read the "Naughty Book"!?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ac: "The "Tomboy Dictionary," hmm... Should she read this?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b3: "What! That special naughty book you keep on you at all times? Are you sure? Isn't it your treasure?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c1: "I can't accept such a precious book. Please have Jessica read another.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12d6: "Jessica is a bit cheeky, but upright and full of energy. Please find a book to restore that personality.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f9: "Mighty, hmm. Now that you mention it, Jessica might have that side. I'll have her read this right away.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1303: Arosa had Jessica read⏎"Secrets of the Mighty"!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130c: "What, Ma, you're here? Leave avenging my brother to me! I'll cut him in half with my Blue Sky Demon Slash!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1319: "...Who's this guy? Angelo-style bangs... how pathetic! Too many wimpy-looking men these days.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1330: "Jessica isn't like this! Please find a book to restore her original personality!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1388: "Jessica isn't like this! Please find a book to restore her original personality!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d7: "Jessica isn't like this! Please find a book to restore her original personality!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|134e: "She didn't seem humorous, but she might show that side in front of friends. I'll have her read this right away.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|136a: "When you're lonely, Sabert's saber and 'sabert' take your mind off it!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1379: "I-I can't laugh... I can't. Jessica, who grieved her brother's death so much, using his name in a dumb joke...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13a2: "Hmm. I'm reluctant to have Jessica read such a dubious book... but if you say so, I'll try.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13b6: "Oh my~, Mother, you're wearing stiff clothes again~. Take them off and enjoy yourself more freely~.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c4: "Hee hee, what a handsome guy. Want a puff-puff from a curvy me~?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13cc: "H-how dare she! She doesn't even surpass my curves... shameless!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e8: "Jessica is not a girl a simple word like tomboy can describe... but let's have her read this for now.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1405: "Thank you. Thanks to you, she's really our Jessica again.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|140d: "I'll stay here a little longer and talk with Jessica before going home.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1417: "But, hearing the details from Jessica's traveling friends, her change may have been a monster's doing...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1425: "By restoring Jessica, you might become a target too. Please be careful from now on.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1433: I want a book to restore⏎Jessica's personality
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1440: "Hee hee. I love you, Mom! Don't go anywhere, stay by my side forever!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|144f: "Hee hee. I love you, Mom! Don't go anywhere, stay by my side forever!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|145f: "...Who are you? Angelo-style bangs... how pathetic! Too many wimpy-looking men these days.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|146e: "More importantly, I gotta go avenge my brother! I'll cut that villain in half with my Blue Sky Demon Slash!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|148a: "Sexy-hot Jessica-chan, favorite color is blue, right?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|149c: "Hee hee, what a handsome guy. Want a puff-puff from a curvy me~?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14ab: "Mom being nice is weird. My back is itching...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14bc: "Lady Jessica was traveling with friends, but suddenly she missed her mother and began to cry...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c8: "So I came with the madam to pick up Lady Jessica.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14d4: "Both Lady Jessica and the madam care about each other deeply. Yet somehow they always quarrel...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14df: "They still quarrel sometimes, but I sense a gentler air in them than before.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f5: "Could it be... you've come to complain to me too?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14fe: "I see... But I truly can't think what I'd be complained about...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1507: "When I handed out the maps, there were lots of Metal Kings here... What's going on?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1523: "...Huh, no? Now that I look, you don't seem to have a treasure map.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|152c: "A treasure map is a mysterious map that makes a cave appear when used. Now adventurers are into trading them.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|153c: "This Unseen Demon's Path is a cave made from a treasure map I found...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1548: "This cave is amazing! You get tons of Metal Kings, the legendary monster!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1551: "I was so happy I wrote my name on the maps and handed them out wherever many people gathered!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|155e: "But a few days later, everyone who got the maps stormed in to yell at me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1569: "'What a map you gave us! We won't take your maps anymore!' they said...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1572: "So I came to check the cave, but I can't make it deep enough with my strength.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|157f: "Please, go deep into this cave in my place and find out what's happening.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1595: "Too bad... I have no reliable companions left. Please accept if you change your mind.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15a9: "Thank you! That helps. I don't have companions to dive into the cave with me anymore.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15b4: "When I came here before, besides Metal Kings often appearing, it was an ordinary cave.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15fc: "When I came here before, besides Metal Kings often appearing, it was an ordinary cave.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15c2: "Go deep, and if you find why everyone and I got out of sync, please fix it while you're at it! I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|160a: "Go deep, and if you find why everyone and I got out of sync, please fix it while you're at it! I'm counting on you!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15db: "This Unseen Demon's Path is a super rare cave even among treasure maps I found!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e8: "I've never heard of another cave with so many Metal Kings, the legendary monster.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f2: "Yet the maps I handed out in good faith angered everyone so much...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|161c: "I've been waiting! How was the back of the cave? Did you learn why everyone got angry?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1627: "Hmm... then sorry, but please check again.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1641: "...What! The Metal Kings merged and took revenge on adventurers!?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|164a: "I see... so that's why everyone who got the maps came to complain to me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1655: "I never imagined revenge. Metal Kings are an adventurer's dream...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1660: "Many adventurers must have gotten hurt chasing Metal Kings too deep.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1669: "Adventurers and Metal Kings push each other to get stronger. That's fine by me.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1675: "...Well! Thanks to you, Metal Kings appear in this cave as before. Thank you truly! This is for you.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1682: "I'll start handing this treasure map out to everyone again.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a1: "I'll start handing this treasure map out to everyone again.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1688: "I hope a superhero who saves the world's crisis will emerge from the adventurers who get this map someday!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a7: "I hope a superhero who saves the world's crisis will emerge from the adventurers who get this map someday!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16b7: "...Now then, next I'll find an even better treasure map and brag to everyone!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16c0: "But just handing it over isn't fun, so next I'll hide it in a locker... I mean a dresser for everyone to find. Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d1: Fix the cause of⏎our getting out of sync
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d5: Fix the cause of⏎our getting out of sync
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e8: "Come to think of it, I'm just a girl with no talent who happened to be born an innkeeper king's daughter...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f5: "I'm so embarrassed to be innkeeper king, I could die. I can't keep running an inn...
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1707: "I forgot something obvious. If I, the innkeeper king, forget to smile, my guests can't smile either.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1717: "Right. Whether I deserve to be innkeeper king doesn't matter.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1720: "To cherish each guest and welcome them with a smile from the heart, that's my pride.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|173a: "This is Luida's tavern. A tavern of meetings and partings where travelers gather to find companions.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1766: "This is Luida's tavern. A tavern of meetings and partings where travelers gather to find companions.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1747: "Oh, you... could you hear me out? Please speak to me from behind the counter.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1773: "Actually, I want to borrow the strength of a seasoned traveler like you. Would you grant my request?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1780: "The girl next door, Rica, is the daughter of an old friend and a very talented innkeeper.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|178d: "In fact, Rica revived this nearly bankrupt Saint Stein inn and won the Innkeeper King Grand Prix.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|179a: "But lately she's been acting strange. She seems to have forgotten her most important pride as innkeeper king.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1835: "But lately she's been acting strange. She seems to have forgotten her most important pride as innkeeper king.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17a7: "I've been thinking what to do, and maybe have her read a book on how a king should be.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17b4: "I think if she reads about a king's ideal, she'll regain her pride as innkeeper king and return to herself.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17c4: "So I want you to find a book that helps Rica regain her pride as innkeeper king. Will you accept?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1850: "So I want you to find a book that helps Rica regain her pride as innkeeper king. Will you accept?
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17dd: "That's a pity. I thought you could find a book.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17f0: "Heh, thank you. I'm confident in judging people. I thought you'd say that.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17fc: "Just my hunch, but a book on kingship should be in a country that values chivalry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1899: "Just my hunch, but a book on kingship should be in a country that values chivalry.
id./param/region/r025.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1808: "I've never heard of one in this world, but if your world has such a country, please look for the book in its castle.

tm.「ここは ルイーダの酒場。\n 旅人たちが 仲間を求めて集まる\n 出会いと別れ: "This is Luida's tavern. A tavern of meetings and partings where travelers gather to find companions.

tm.「隣にいる リッカって子は\n 私の 古い友人の娘で\n とても才能のある 宿屋: "The girl next door, Rica, is the daughter of an old friend and a very talented innkeeper.

tm.「本を読んで 王の あるべき姿を思いだせば\n 宿王としての誇りを取り戻し\n: "I think if she reads about a king's ideal, she'll regain her pride as innkeeper king and return to herself.
tm.「というわけで あなたには リッカが\n 宿王の誇りを取り戻せるような 本を探し: "So I want you to find a book that helps Rica regain her pride as innkeeper king. Will you accept?
